obligations.scope_review: The fixed LeasePool capacity and arbitrary PoolTrace bound are audited. A held lease refuses a reservation. Total-pool saturation and indexed admission branches in modules 37 and 39 still need a source-to-witness audit.

witnesses.name: heldReservationDenied
witnesses.establishes: A held lease produces no owned reservation token for every generation.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Local denial alone does not state that zero total availability implies every indexed admission is refused.

witnesses.name: pendingOccupancyTraceBound
witnesses.statement:
(trace : PoolTrace) -> (pool : LeasePool) ->
    AtMost (leaseOccupancy (runPool trace pool)) (leaseCapacity pool)
witnesses.establishes: Every finite PoolTrace preserves occupancy at most the initial LeasePool capacity.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: PoolTrace contains reserveAt and completeAt; pre-validation queues and established resources are separate.

witnesses.name: pendingConservationTrace
witnesses.statement:
(trace : PoolTrace) -> (pool : LeasePool) ->
    Equal Count (add (leaseOccupancy (runPool trace pool)) (leaseAvailability (runPool trace pool)))
      (leaseCapacity pool)
witnesses.establishes: Occupancy plus availability equals initial capacity after every finite PoolTrace.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Conservation does not state the saturated indexed admission decision.

criteria.rationale: The local held-slot refusal is general over generations; the required total-capacity refusal bridge is not audited.
criteria.remaining: Audit a general implication from exhausted total pending capacity to refusal for every indexed admission branch in modules 37 and 39.

criteria.rationale: The bound and conservation statements quantify over every finite modeled PoolTrace and initial LeasePool.

obligations.scope_review: Audited local terminal reasons, unowned no-op, duplicate release and arbitrarily old generations. Indexed receipt ownership and whole-pool baseline restoration across every terminal branch remain unaudited.

witnesses.name: unownedCompletionNoRefund
witnesses.statement:
(reason : PendingEnd) -> (lease : Lease) ->
    Equal Lease (pendingCompletion noOwnedLease reason lease) lease
witnesses.establishes: An unowned completion is a no-op for every terminal reason and lease.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Single lease terms; no theorem here relates arbitrary indexed receipts to whole-pool baseline restoration.

witnesses.name: repeatedTerminalReasonsIdempotent
witnesses.statement:
(token : CompletionToken) ->
    (first : PendingEnd) -> (second : PendingEnd) -> (lease : Lease) ->
    Equal Lease (pendingCompletion token second (pendingCompletion token first lease))
      (pendingCompletion token first lease)
witnesses.establishes: A second terminal reason with the same token does not release again, for every token and lease.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Single lease terms; no theorem here relates arbitrary indexed receipts to whole-pool baseline restoration.

witnesses.name: arbitrarilyOldGenerationPreserved
witnesses.statement:
(generation : Count) -> (gap : Count) ->
    Equal Lease (releaseOwned generation (heldLease (next (add generation gap))))
      (heldLease (next (add generation gap)))
witnesses.establishes: An old generation cannot release a held successor generation separated by any finite gap.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: The generation has the stated successor-plus-gap form; arbitrary slot-index and generation receipt validity still needs review.

witnesses.name: everyTerminalReasonReleases
witnesses.statement:
(generation : Count) -> (reason : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal Lease (pendingCompletion (ownedGeneration generation) reason (heldLease generation))
      (freeLease (next generation))
witnesses.establishes: A matching owned generation releases for failure, establishment, hook refusal, timeout and cancellation.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Single lease terms; no theorem here relates arbitrary indexed receipts to whole-pool baseline restoration.

criteria.rationale: The local no-op, idempotence and old-generation statements are general, but receipt-to-pool ownership has not been audited.
criteria.remaining: Audit unowned, repeated and arbitrary stale indexed callbacks through full-pool transitions, including unrelated live slots.

criteria.rationale: All five modeled owned terminal reasons release the matching local lease.
criteria.remaining: Audit every owned terminal outcome from its indexed receipt to correct-slot removal and whole-pool baseline occupancy.

obligations.scope_review: Audited fixed source-table width under arbitrary SourceSystemTrace and protected-cell eviction. Multiple-prefix attribution, restart/epoch lifetime rules and the full shared T4b/T8 security-state bridge remain unaudited.

witnesses.name: sourceSystemTraceSlotBound
witnesses.statement:
(events : SourceSystemTrace) -> (capacity : Count) -> (table : SourceTable) ->
    AtMost (sourceTableSize (runSourceSystem events capacity table)) (sourceTableWidth table)
witnesses.establishes: Resident source-table size never exceeds its initial fixed width under every finite SourceSystemTrace.
premises: SourceTable has a fixed finite slot width; transitions are the modeled registration, eviction and enforcement events.
witnesses.limits: Count keys do not themselves establish IPv4/IPv6 prefix attribution or restart retention.

witnesses.name: sourceCellEvictionPreservesProtection
witnesses.establishes: The protected projection of every SourceCell is unchanged by evictSourceCell.
premises: Protected debt and ban constructors are preserved; only clear entries can be evicted.
witnesses.limits: Single-cell eviction is not a general restart, re-registration or multi-prefix lifetime theorem.

criteria.rationale: The statement bounds every modeled trace and initial table by that table fixed finite width.
Eviction preserves local protected state; the larger lifecycle requirement has not been audited.
criteria.remaining: Audit protected debt/ban persistence across arbitrary re-registration, shared source/prefix accounting and restart/epoch transitions.

obligations.scope_review: Audited the general aggregate burst-plus-trusted-ticks envelope and a closed two-swarm example. Distinct source/prefix time envelopes, IPv4/IPv6 attribution, fresh identities and trusted traffic remain unaudited; the example does not establish those general scopes.

witnesses.name: sourceAdmissionBurstRateEnvelope
witnesses.statement:
(trace : TimedSourceAdmissionTrace) -> (quota : Count) ->
    (capacity : Count) -> (burst : Count) -> (rate : Count) -> (current : SourceAdmission) ->
    AtMost (admissionCredits current) burst ->
    AtMost (sourceAdmissionStarts (timedSourceAdmissions trace rate) quota capacity current)
      (add burst (multiply (sourceAdmissionTrustedTicks trace) rate))
witnesses.establishes: Aggregate successful starts over every TimedSourceAdmissionTrace are at most burst plus trusted ticks times rate.
premises: Explicit proof argument: AtMost (admissionCredits current) burst.
Only authoritative trusted tick events issue credits; the modeled admission decisions enforce their defined checks.
witnesses.limits: The conclusion counts aggregate starts; it does not state a separate time envelope for every source or IPv4/IPv6 prefix.

witnesses.name: admissionRateCountsBothSwarms
witnesses.statement:
Equal Count
    (sourceAdmissionStarts (timedSourceAdmissions admissionRateReuseTrace (next zero))
      (next zero) (next zero) admissionExampleReady) (next (next zero))
witnesses.establishes: The fixed admissionRateReuseTrace counts two successful starts, one from each swarm.
premises: The exact closed admissionRateReuseTrace, admissionExampleReady state and unit quota/capacity/rate are fixed.
witnesses.limits: No arbitrary state, trace, prefix or swarm-allocation quantifier occurs in this statement.

criteria.rationale: The aggregate envelope is general; the two-swarm reuse result is only a finite example.
criteria.remaining: Audit distinct source/prefix and aggregate burst-plus-rate envelopes across all swarms, trusted traffic and fresh identities.

criteria.rationale: The exact initial-credit premise and trusted-tick aggregate scope are retained without crediting the closed example as general.
criteria.remaining: Audit IPv4/IPv6 prefix attribution, unvalidated victim-address rejection and the relevant conditional/failure branches for the complete rate requirement.
